templates.name: Pool
templates.description: Quarterly pool water quality, equipment, and safety equipment inspection.

steps.label: Check the water level.
Check the water temperature. Recommended temperatures are 85° for the pool.
Check water clarity. Drain and refill only if necessary.
Check all pool chemical levels. Record appropriately in the Pool Operator’s Log. Ensure this is being completed daily.
Check the condition of all ladders, cove molding, and rescue equipment.
Vacuum and brush all tiled surfaces and pool floor as needed.
Make sure all proper signage is posted.

templates.name: Elevator Checklist
templates.description: Monthly elevator preventive maintenance and safety checklist. Assign this template to each applicable elevator or elevator equipment area.

steps.label: Check the general condition of all elevators.
Check and clean elevator pits and tracks.
Test the fire recall system.
Test the elevator safety phone.
Check that elevator/pump rooms are clean.
Test emergency lighting.
Complete any required elevator safety inspections or checks applicable to the property.

templates.name: Administrative Offices
templates.description: Preventative Maintenance

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition

templates.name: Fire Extinguishers
templates.description: Monthly fire extinguisher inspection. Assign this template to all applicable property locations; long-term vendor testing is managed separately.

steps.label: Inspect the general condition of each fire extinguisher.
Confirm each extinguisher is present and properly positioned.
Inspect cabinets and mounting brackets; clean as needed.
Inspect extinguisher hoses for visible damage.
Confirm inspection tags are signed and dated monthly and annually.
Confirm each extinguisher indicates proper charge.

templates.name: Building Exterior
templates.description: Triannual building exterior inspection covering finishes, openings, and visible deterioration. Assign to the property exterior or primary building area.

steps.label: Inspect building exterior for visible damage, deterioration, leaks, damaged finishes, windows, doors, seals, and caulking
Inspect parking lot, curbs, striping, and sidewalks for cracks, potholes, trip hazards, drainage issues, and needed repairs
Inspect landscaping and grounds for overgrowth, dead or damaged vegetation, irrigation issues, debris, and general condition
Inspect exterior lighting, signage, fencing, gates, and other exterior fixtures for damage or needed repairs
Clean and complete minor routine repairs as needed
Document deficiencies and create a work order or contact a qualified contractor when specialized repairs are required

templates.name: Corridors (Hallways)
templates.description: Quarterly corridor and hallway condition inspection by floor.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition

templates.name: Boilers / Water Heaters
templates.description: PM Water Heaters #1, #2, #3, #4

steps.label: Ensure there are no leaks and record the temperature.
Drain water off the bottom valve unit until clear water is present.
Ensure that the pressure relief valve is sized properly and there are no leaks. Record the temperature.
Check the water temperature in a room (120° - 125° maximum).
Clean the burner assembly and check circulation pumps are working properly

templates.name: Dining & Breakfast Area
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for the dining and breakfast area.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition
Inspect breakfast-area tables and chairs for damage, loose components, nicks, or scratches.
Verify proper lighting and replace failed lamps as needed.
Test GFCI outlets for proper operation.

templates.name: Dumpster Area
templates.description: Quarterly dumpster area inspection covering cleanliness, enclosure condition, and odor control.

steps.label: Check for stains, odor and garbage.
Ensure that the closure works properly and can be closed completely.
Ensure the trash enclosure is in good condition.
Pressure wash dumpster area as needed.

templates.name: Employee Breakroom
templates.description: Preventative Maintenance

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition

templates.name: Employee Restroom
templates.description: Preventative Maintenance

steps.label: Check the following and repair as needed: Walls, floors, ceilings, hardware, toilet
Touch up door frames
Clean and inspect the exhaust fan.

templates.name: Boiler/Water Heater Room
templates.description: PM Hot Water Heater Room

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition
Ensure that all electrical panels and disconnects are properly labeled.
Organize and inventory tools and supplies.

templates.name: Electrical Rooms
templates.description: Quarterly electrical room inspection covering room condition, exhaust, combustibles, and panel fillers.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition
Touch up the door frames.
Test all exhaust vents.
Clean and organize the entire room.
Ensure no combustibles present in room.
Ensure no missing breaker slots in the electrical panel. Place breaker filler as needed.

templates.name: Emergency Lights
templates.description: Quarterly emergency lighting inspection covering lamp operation, test buttons, and battery condition.

steps.label: Inspect all lights, and replace any that are burned out. All floors.
Ensure that all emergency lights work by pressing the red “Test” button.
Check the battery charge. Replace any defective or dead batteries as soon as possible.

templates.name: Relay
templates.description: Quarterly relay and beacon device battery and alarm function inspection.

steps.label: Change beacon batteries located throughout the building.
Ensure all devices are working properly. Test alarm feature for all devices.
Relay Admin Portal and review beacon locations are functioning properly

templates.name: Engineering Shop
templates.description: Quarterly engineering shop inspection covering room finishes, organization, and cleanliness.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition
Touch up door frames.
Organize paperwork, tools and equipment

templates.name: Entry Foyer
templates.description: Quarterly entry foyer inspection covering finishes, doors, locks, intercom, and luggage carts.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition
Touch up doors and door frames.
Test locks.
Test intercom.
Check overall condition of luggage carts and repair as needed.

templates.name: Public Space AC Units
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for the front desk / public space VTEC unit.

steps.label: Check/Clean evaporator coils and condenser coils as needed
Clean and change air filter.
Clean and Vacuum drain line.
Ensure unit is not making any alarming or loud noises.
Using temperature gun ensure the unit is producing air between 55 to 64 degrees.

legacyNames: Front Desk - Public Space VTEC Unit

templates.name: Fire System Flow
templates.description: Quarterly fire system flow and contracted inspection tracking checklist.

steps.label: Contract out - Annual Alarm Panel Inspection
Contract out - Annual testing and Maintenance of Standpipe and Hose Systems
Contract out - Quarterly Testing and Maintenance of Wet Pipe Sprinkler System
Contract out - Annual Fire Hydrant Flow Test
Contract Out - Annual, all Backflows, Prevention Assembly Test
Contract out - Annual Testing and Maintenance of Wet Pipe Sprinkler System

templates.name: Fitness Center
templates.description: Quarterly fitness center finishes and equipment preventive maintenance.

steps.label: Inspect, clean, and repair the area as needed: walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, outlets, and general condition
Ensure that all equipment works correctly.

templates.name: Roof Maintenance
templates.description: Quarterly roof inspection covering drains, seams, flashing, and ventilation.

steps.label: Inspect the roof surface for damage, wear, ponding water, or other deterioration
Inspect seams, flashing, penetrations, parapets, and equipment curbs; repair/seal as needed
Clean and clear roof drains
Inspect walk pads and roof access areas; ensure they are secure and in good condition

templates.name: Rooftop Exhausts
templates.description: Quarterly rooftop exhaust inspection. Add additional exhaust items as needed; each item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect the general condition and operation of rooftop exhausts.
Check and tighten electrical connections.
Ensure that the wheel and blade are clean.
Check alignment of belts and pulley.
Check all dampers.
Inspect control wiring.
Check fan-blade guard.

templates.name: Rooftop Units
templates.description: Quarterly rooftop unit (RTU) preventive maintenance. Checklist steps to be added later. Each RTU item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect overall unit condition and operation; check for unusual noise, vibration, or damage
Inspect and replace/clean filters as needed
If specialized service or repairs are needed, contact a qualified technician

templates.name: Housekeeping Carts
templates.description: Quarterly housekeeping cart inspection covering wheels, hardware, and finish.

steps.label: Check the wheels on all carts, and repair or replace as needed.
Tighten all nuts, bolts, and related supports.
If needed, paint or touch up all carts.

templates.name: Water Softener
templates.description: Quarterly water softener inspection covering hardness, salt/brine levels, leaks, and valves.

steps.label: Check alignment of the drain line over the floor drain.
Inspect/test water hardness.
Inspect salt and water levels in the tank according to manufacturer's recommendations.
Ensure brine tank automatic fill is operating properly.
Inspect piping, fittings, and valves for leaks.
Lubricate all valves.
Clean the surrounding area.

templates.name: Refrigerators and Freezers
templates.description: Quarterly refrigerator and cooler inspection. Add additional refrigerator items as needed; each item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect and clean interior/exterior; check doors, hinges, gaskets, and seals.
Check temperature and verify proper airflow.
Clean condenser coils; inspect evaporator coils for debris, frost, or ice buildup
Inspect and clean condensate pain and drain line as needed
Inspect electrical supply, connections, and controls for proper operation
Check for unusual noise, vibration, leaks, or other signs of improper operation
Clean under and behind the units

templates.name: Chlorine Feeders
templates.description: Semiannual chlorine feeder inspection and routine maintenance. Assign to the pool equipment room or applicable chemical feed area.

steps.label: Inspect general condition of chlorine feeder(s).
Inspect lid, seals, fittings, and connections for visible wear or damage.
Inspect input and output hoses for leaks, cracks, deterioration, or loose connections.
Clean accessible components as needed.
Verify feeder appears to be operating normally.
Contact the pool service provider or qualified contractor for chemical-system repairs or service beyond routine maintenance.

templates.name: Juice Machine
templates.description: Quarterly juice machine electrical inspection and service checklist.

steps.label: Clean and inspect machine
Inspect electrical cord, plug, and connections.
Inspect for any signs of leaking

templates.name: Ice Machines
templates.description: Quarterly ice machine inspection and basic mechanical service checklist.

steps.label: Check the overall condition of all ice machines.
Ensure that discharge lines are aligned with the floor drains.
Ensure coil fins are straight.
Ensure the shroud is in its proper position.
Level each unit, front to rear and side to side.
Ensure all electrical connections are tight.
Repair or replace any parts as needed.

templates.name: Dishwasher / Sanitizer
templates.description: Quarterly inspection, cleaning, and operational service for commercial dishwashing and sanitizing equipment.

steps.label: Inspect the unit, doors, racks, curtains, and accessible components for damage or abnormal wear.
Inspect for water, chemical, or steam leaks and repair or create a work order as needed.
Inspect accessible electrical wiring and connections for visible damage, overheating, or looseness. Contact a qualified contractor when repair is required.
Verify wash and rinse temperatures meet the equipment manufacturer and applicable sanitation requirements.
Clean accessible screens, strainers, spray arms, nozzles, and interior surfaces as needed.
Drain and flush the unit according to manufacturer instructions.
Delime the unit according to manufacturer instructions using the property’s approved deliming product.
Run an operational cycle and verify proper filling, washing, rinsing, draining, and shutdown.

templates.name: Commercial Dryer
templates.description: Preventive maintenance for commercial dryers. Each unit keeps independent completion and maintenance history.

steps.label: Run dryer and listen for excessive noise or vibration.
Inspect and clean lint screen, lint compartment, and accessible lint buildup.
Inspect drive belts for looseness, wear, cracks, or fraying.
Inspect door, hinges, latch, and door gasket for wear or damage.
Inspect and clean accessible burner area and burner air openings.
Inspect and clean accessible exhaust duct and vent for lint buildup or restriction.
Check accessible fasteners and hardware for looseness; tighten as needed.
Contact a qualified contractor for gas-system repairs, burner service, electrical repairs, or specialized repairs as needed.

templates.name: Commercial Washing Machine
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for commercial washing machines. Each unit keeps independent completion and maintenance history.

steps.label: Clean drain trough/lint trap.
Check for loose, frayed, damaged, or overheated wiring. Create a work order or contact a qualified contractor if repair is required.
Check for water or chemical leaks.
Check and clean accessible drain lines as needed.
Grease/lubricate applicable fittings according to manufacturer recommendations.
Run a test cycle and verify proper operation.

templates.name: Laundry Room
templates.description: Quarterly laundry room finishes, lighting, and linen chute inspection.

steps.label: Clean and repair walls, floors, ceilings, electrical connection, signage, and hardware.
Touch up door frames as needed.
Clean lights and pipes.
Check the overall condition of the linen chute. Door closes properly. Chute is clear of obstructions. Chute is clean.

templates.name: Lighting & Signage
templates.description: Quarterly exterior lighting and signage inspection covering operation, focus, and cleanliness.

steps.label: Ensure that all lights are working and focused.
Check and correct any lighting obstructions (for example, tree branches and bushes).
Clean inside and outside of wall mounted lights as needed.

templates.name: Linen and Storage Rooms
templates.description: Quarterly linen and storage room inspection covering finishes, organization, and cleanliness.

steps.label: Be sure to check the following and repair as needed: Walls, floors, ceilings, electrical connections, signage, hardware.
Touch up door frames as needed.
Organize shelves and replacement supplies.
Clean floors, light fixtures, electrical switches and plates, hand floor and mop sinks, fixtures and plumbing.

templates.name: Guest Dryer
templates.description: Quarterly guest dryer preventive maintenance for guest laundry.

steps.label: Run dryer and listen for excessive noise or vibration.
Pull out all unit: clean under and behind it.
Inspect and clean accessible exhaust duct and vent for lint buildup or restriction
Clean each unit thoroughly.
Run each unit through a complete cycle.

templates.name: Guest Washer
templates.description: Quarterly guest washer preventive maintenance for guest laundry.

steps.label: Run each unit through a complete cycle.
Clean behind and under each unit.
Check all hoses & gaskets for leaks. Replace as needed.
Clean each unit thoroughly.
Lubricate all bearings.
Pull out all units and clean behind them.
Inspect and change all hoses as needed.

templates.name: Lobby & Front Desk
templates.description: Quarterly lobby, front desk, and market area public-space inspection.

steps.label: Check the overall condition of your lobby and front desk; be sure to check each of the following, and touch up, repair, or replace as needed: Walls, floors, ceilings, signage, front desk, and furniture.
Check the overall condition of Market Area; be sure to touch up, repair, or replace equipment and cabinetry as needed.
Test all electrical outlets.
Ensure all common space TVs are working properly.

templates.name: Vacuums
templates.description: Quarterly vacuum cleaner inspection and service. Add additional vacuum items as needed; each item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Check each machine's hose and attachments.
Check each vacuum's switches, as well as the power cord. Replace any cords that are frayed or damaged.
Each vacuum should be completely disassembled. Then, clean each individual part.
Check the condition of each machine's motor, as well as the roller assembly.
Check all parts, and repair or replace as necessary.
Clean debris from beater bar or brush.
Change brushes and belts as needed.

templates.name: Meeting Room
templates.description: Quarterly meeting room AV, locks, phones, and HVAC inspection.

steps.label: Check the overall condition of your meeting rooms, and be sure to check the following and repair or replace as needed: Lights, screens, and projector.
Test all locks.
Test all phones and jacks.
Ensure that enough extension cords are available.
Test HVAC.

templates.name: Outdoor Furniture
templates.description: Quarterly outdoor furniture inspection for pool and fire pit seating areas.

steps.label: Inspect furniture for damage, cracks, loose parts, or excessive wear.
Tighten loose hardware and fasteners as needed.
Inspect tables and chairs for stability; repair as needed.
Clean furniture and remove stains, dirt, mildew, and debris.
Inspect finishes for fading, peeling, rust, or corrosion; touch up as needed.
Confirm furniture is properly positioned and the area is neat and orderly.

templates.name: Pool Circulation Pump
templates.description: Quarterly pool circulation pump inspection covering mounts, baskets, leaks, and wiring.

steps.label: Inspect motor floor mounts, motor pump mounts, proper grounding, and proper flow of water (150).
Clean baskets (purge air after if needed).
Clean outside the motor to avoid oxidation.
Check casing for leaks.
Secure the wiring assembly.

templates.name: Pool Filter
templates.description: Quarterly pool filter inspection covering condition, backwash, leaks, and pressure.

steps.label: Inspect the general condition of all filters.
Check emergency shutoffs.
Backwash as needed.
Check for any leaks, and repair if needed.
Clean entire unit.
Ensure that pressure is within recommended limits (over 100).
Every 3 months clean inside all filters. Replace filter if needed.

templates.name: Pool Heater
templates.description: Quarterly pool heater inspection covering shutoffs, ignition, pipes, fans, and burners.

steps.label: Inspect the general condition of emergency shutoffs.
Inspect the general condition of outgoing temperature.
Inspect ignition device.
Inspect pipes.
Check water temperature in pool.
Inspect room intake fan(s) and exhaust fan(s).
Clean burners.

templates.name: Phone/TV/Computer Room
templates.description: Quarterly phone/TV/computer room finishes, temperature, and cleanliness inspection.

steps.label: Check and repair walls, ceiling, floors, outlets, signage, hardware.
Room temperature. Must be maintained at 75° or less.
Touch up the door frames.
Clean the entire room.

templates.name: Public Restrooms
templates.description: Quarterly public restroom finishes, plumbing, and fixture inspection.

steps.label: Check the overall condition of your public restrooms and repair as needed: Walls, floors, ceilings, signage, outlets, and hardware.
Touch up all door frames.
Test all plumbing.
Inspect and clean exhaust fan.
Replace any tarnished or worn fixtures.
Check any vending machines and have them repaired or replaced as needed.

templates.name: Stairwells
templates.description: Quarterly stairwell finishes, lighting, and handrail inspection.

steps.label: Check all of the following, and clean, repair, re-paint, or replace as needed: walls, vinyl, door jambs, ceiling, carpets, cove base, outlets, signage, lights, and hand railing.
